name: rentados-backend
description: API backend para Rentados — administración de conjuntos residenciales

scripts.dev:5578: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev -- --port 5578 --strictPort"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:host: VITE_API_BASE=https://rentados-backend.onrender.com/api/v1 npm --prefix web run build && rm -rf host && mkdir -p host && cp -R web/dist/. host/ && cp host/index.html host/404.html && node scripts/write-host-routes.js && find host -name '.DS_Store' -delete && rm -f host/assets/.gitkeep host/assets/README.md
